semantics.summary: Returns a random real number; the 3.5 Chapter 18 example uses RND(1) inside INT(RND(1)*5).

printed-pages: Base-manual function definition, printed pp. 4-17–4-18 (3.0-origin range/argument notes only)
notes: The 3.5-labelled example directly demonstrates the one-argument form. The 3.0 base text says the optional parameter has no meaning and describes a [0,1) result; this detailed range/parameter behavior is not independently restated in Chapter 18. RANDOM and RANDOMIZE are not confirmed by this occurrence.
